question: Listá los fármacos con target PDCD1 o CD274 (anti-PD-1 o anti-PD-L1) que tienen ensayos de fase 3 (incluye fase 2/3) en cáncer de pulmón.

attempts.query:
SELECT DISTINCT d.pref_name
FROM linking.drug d
JOIN linking.drug_target dt ON dt.parent_chembl_id = d.chembl_id
JOIN linking.target_gene tg ON tg.target_chembl_id = dt.target_chembl_id
JOIN linking.trial_drug td ON td.parent_chembl_id = d.chembl_id
JOIN aact.studies s ON s.nct_id = td.nct_id
JOIN linking.trial_condition tc ON tc.nct_id = td.nct_id
JOIN mesh.ancestor a ON a.id = tc.mesh_id
JOIN mesh.descriptor md ON md.id = a.ancestor_id
WHERE tg.gene_symbol IN ('PDCD1','CD274')
  AND s.phase IN ('PHASE3','PHASE2/PHASE3')
  AND md.label = 'Lung Neoplasms'
ORDER BY d.pref_name
